name: Silas
appearance: Silas is lean and wiry, with observant grey eyes that constantly scan his surroundings. He moves with a quiet, almost predatory grace, his movements fluid and economical.
personality: Sly, cynical, and highly independent. Silas is a pragmatist who trusts few and relies on his own skills. He possesses a dry wit that surfaces occasionally, often in the form of sarcastic remarks.
background: Silas grew up in the grimy back alleys of the city, learning to survive by his wits and nimble fingers. He has developed into a ruthless pragmatist.

equipment.name: Shortsword
equipment.description: Short and narrow, its edge kept dark with poison.

equipment.name: Hand Crossbow
equipment.description: Small enough to carry under his coat, its bolts poisoned like his blade.

equipment.name: Thieves' Tools
equipment.description: Masterwork lockpicks in a small leather pouch, his most prized possessions.

equipment.name: Grappling Hook and Rope
equipment.description: Compact and easily concealed, useful for scaling walls.

equipment.name: Coin Pouch
equipment.description: A modest amount of gold and silver, enough for immediate needs.
